verdict.rationale:
uv provides non-interactive dependency management commands (uv add, uv remove, uv lock --upgrade-package, uv sync) with deterministic lockfile updates and CI integration (setup-uv action) suitable for agentic/scripted use, and community reports confirm it 'just works' without prompts in automated pipelines. However, the evidence never documents specific exit-code semantics or structured error output for failure cases, and some community reports mention resolver quirks/edge-case errors that aren't clearly surfaced.
missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit codes, structured/machine-readable error output on failure, and hands-on confirmation of clear error messaging in CI.
